25.title: 3V3 Deathmatch
25.text: After contestants are matched, they will use virtual Soldiers and engage in 3v3 battles. The contestant that wins will advance to the next round, until all his/her squads are eliminated. Attacker/Defender roles are randomly assigned.

24.title: Prediction Reward
24.text: All Lords can make up to 5 Predictions daily using Recluse Coins for a chance to earn substantial Recluse Coin rewards. Failed Predictions incur no penalty.

23.title: Server-Wide Celebration
23.text: Every contestant in the Elimination will earn a Ranking Reward for all Lords on their server.

22.title: Supreme Glory
22.text: The winning contestant of the Elimination Finals will be crowned Supreme, earning an exclusive animated Emoji and unique Avatar Frame.

21.title: Battle to the End
21.text: In the Elimination Phase, each contestant competes in 3 matches, requiring 2 wins to advance. In the Finals, each contestant competes in 5 matches, requiring 3 wins to claim victory.

14.title: Best of Three
14.text: Each contestant's Rematch consists of 3 battles. Win 2 out of 3 to secure victory.

13.title: Relay Matches
13.text: During Rematch Phase, a contestant will face 2 opponents daily for the first three days, then 1 opponent since day four. All contestants will face each other once during Rematch phase.

16.title: Server-Wide Celebration
16.text: Contestants who earn Ranking Rewards in their group will secure bonus rewards for all Lords on their servers.

15.title: Elite Gathering
15.text: The top 2 contestants in each Rematch group will advance to the Elimination phase.

1.title: Join Now
1.text: Once Supreme Duel begins, all Lords across 16 Kingdoms with Sanctuaries Lv.20+ are eligible to register and compete.

2.title: Abundant Events
2.text: Brave Lords from 16 Kingdoms will face off across multiple rounds, defeat opponents to claim massive rewards, and compete for ultimate supreme glory.

20.title: Single Elimination
20.text: During Elimination, a single defeat results in immediate elimination. You cannot participate in subsequent matches.

11.title: Grand Celebration Reset
11.text: When Preliminaries begin, all rewards from Grand Celebration will reset. Donate your Supreme Fireworks generously to earn Recluse Coins.

17.text: All Lords can make up to 5 Predictions daily using Recluse Coins for a chance to earn substantial Recluse Coin rewards. Failed Predictions incur no penalty.

18.title: Points Rules
18.text: Battles use the highest Level Soldiers available when the contestant's Lineup was saved. For each opponent's Lv.N Soldier defeated (including lightly wounded, heavily wounded, or defeated), (1+N)×6 points will be granted. For each of your Lv.N Soldiers surviving a battle, (1+N)×9 points will be granted. Your battle points equal the sum of both.

9.title: Server-Wide Celebration
9.text: Contestants who earn Ranking Rewards in their group will secure bonus rewards for all Lords on their servers.

7.title: Vie for Victory
7.text: During the Preliminaries, each contestant will be automatically matched with 8 opponents of similar strength for 4 days, with rankings determined by battle points.

8.title: The Strongest Prevails
8.text: The top 8 contestants by battle points in the Preliminaries will advance to the next round.

5.title: Seeded Player
5.text: Lords ranked in the top 8 of their Kingdom's Hero total Might Rankings will be automatically designated as seeded contestants upon registration.

6.title: Grand Contest
6.text: When grouping contestants, Seed Players from the same Kingdom will be distributed across different groups as much as possible to compete for the ultimate glory.

3.title: Prediction Reward
3.text: When the Event reaches the Rematch and Elimination Phases, a Prediction activity will unlock—support your favorite contestants and earn generous rewards!

4.title: Grand Celebration
4.text: During the registration phase, earn Supreme Fireworks from Daily Quest Chests. Donate your Supreme Fireworks to celebrate the grand event across all 16 Kingdoms and earn Recluse Coins as reward.
